text: ぼくは　ゲーム　デザイナー　ポケモンずかん　ぜんぶ　あつめるの　たいへん　だけど　がんばって！

structure.jp: ぼくは　ゲーム　デザイナー
ポケモンずかん　ぜんぶ　あつめるの　たいへん　だけど
structure.en: filling the whole Pokédex is tough, but

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about. あつめるの = 'collecting them'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts with 'but'. たいへん　だけど = 'it's tough, but'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in て on its own is a friendly way to ask someone to do something. がんばって = 'do your best'.
